mentions.name: Renamify
mentions.description: A renaming tool shipped with a VS Code extension and an MCP server for handy code renames. Version 0.5.0 was just launched with new features, and the site includes case studies of real renames.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm quite proud of this renaming tool as well: https://docspring.github.io/renamify/

I just finished some new features today and launched v0.5.0. The VS Code extension and MCP server are both really handy.
